dedupe_keys.name: data underlying the research of positive displacement reversible pump turbine mechanical load

description: NTNU provides a modelling setup for mechanical loading of an ALPHEUS reversible lobe pump-turbine. ANSYS CFX and TwinMesh calculate the maximum surface pressure during one revolution. That pressure is applied as a boundary condition for mechanical load and displacement assessment in ANSYS Mechanical. The source connects the machine to potential low-head pumped-hydro storage applications. Coverage: No complete measurement interval or evaluation extent is stated in the reviewed source. Access: public native metadata describes the release and its formats. Licence: CC-BY-SA-4.0. Cost and current distribution access remain unknown. Caveats: The release includes solver files and figures in archives, whose contents were not retrieved. Related validation and design-parameter studies have separate native identities. Full meshes, boundary conditions, solver language and structural results remain unverified.
inputs: Pump-turbine geometry, operating case and simulated surface-pressure boundary conditions.
